title: Object Storage: outage credit — incident uptime assessment
content:
For Object Storage outage credit, read uptime percent from the latest completed storage incident linked to that exact source charge; incident chronology is ordered by recorded occurrence time. At or above the storage tier uptime target percentage the bracket is zero; otherwise use the first descending descending uptime credit brackets fraction whose minimum is no greater than the recorded uptime. Read incident origin on the same latest completed source-linked incident.
